question_text:
16. In General Electric (GE) Nine-Cell Matrix, which two dimensions form the
basis of portfolio analysis to develop the strategic options?
(A)  Business Strength and Market Attractiveness
(B)  Company's Strength and Weakness
(C)  Market Share and Market Growth Rate
(D)  Competitive Intensity and Pricing Trends
(1 Mark)
Answer Key
MCQ. No.
Correct Answer
